name: AHMED-MD
description: A premium, high-speed multi-device WhatsApp bot built for advanced moderation, rich media processing, and seamless performance.

SESSION_ID.description: Your WhatsApp pairing session ID. Get it from ahmedxmd.com

OWNER_NUMBER.description: The phone number of the bot owner (with country code, no + or spaces).

MODE.description: Work mode of the bot (public or private).

MONGODB_URI.description: MongoDB URI connection string for settings and database persistence.

STATUS_REACTION_EMOJIS.description: Custom emojis for auto status reaction (comma separated).
